quote.text: Thou art a little soul bearing about a corpse, as Epictetus used to say. It is no evil for things to undergo change, and no good for things to subsist in consequence of change.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that just as the body is ever-changing, your children are evolving souls; embrace their growth with an open heart, accepting that transformation is natural.
    • Allow flexibility in your guidance—like nature, their lives unfold unpredictably. Foster an environment where change is seen as a path to learning rather than a source of fear.
  • Leadership
    • Embrace change as a leader; the impermanence of circumstances requires you to be adaptable, guiding others through uncertainty with wisdom and calm resolve.
    • Lead by example by accepting transformation in your strategies and decisions. This approach builds a resilient team that thrives on innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Product Management
    • Understand that products, like the body and soul, are in constant flux. Each iteration, feedback, and market shift is an opportunity to refine and redefine your vision.
    • Approach challenges with the mindset that change is not an adversary but a catalyst for progress. Adapt your product strategy accordingly to remain dynamic and customer-focused.
